title: Term Life Insurance Administrative Charge Courtesy After a Recent Whole Life Insurance Terminal Illness Advance
content:
**Courtesy terms — Term Life Insurance.** The share of the acceleration administrative charge collected depends on whether the owner had a terminal illness advance paid on an Ashgrove whole life policy (Whole Life Insurance) within the 12 months ending today, and on the physician-certified life expectancy on the approved term claim:

| Whole life terminal illness advance paid within the 12 months ending today | Life expectancy | Courtesy share of the administrative charge |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 9 months or less | one half (0.5) |
| yes | 10 months or more | three quarters (0.75) |
| no | any | the whole charge |

The whole life advance is read from the terminal illness advance entries on the owner's whole life policies' activity history by their payment dates.

Hypothetical: a charge before courtesy of 100.00 with a whole life advance paid 5 months ago and a life expectancy of 8 months — 50.00. A charge of 150.00 with a whole life advance paid 5 months ago and a life expectancy of 11 months — 112.50. The same with the whole life advance paid 14 months ago — 150.00.
